**Where each seed ran.** Every netlist was elaborated on chip-30x0-ai-dev. The baseline and FBLD alone's seeds 1 to 3 were fitted there; FBLD alone's seed 4 and the head's four were fitted on Powerboat, with the same Quartus Pro 26.3.0 Build 114, on the same netlist bytes (copied, sha256 compared), each under Powerboat's Pro lease, after chip's shared lease went to other sessions' jobs for two hours ([run-status.txt](run-status.txt)).

| Build | Seeds | Median | Spread | Against the baseline | Larger spread | One-sided verdict | Against #2037's head | Timing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| FBLD alone (`b4213b4d6`) | 4 | 42,425.5 | 126 | **+262.5 saved** | 126 | pass | +151.0 saved | all pass |
| the head (`d74d8d419`) | 4 | 42,227.5 | 49 | **+460.5 saved** | 90 | pass | +349.0 saved | all pass |

Each change's share: FBLD on the engine +262.5 (the baseline less FBLD alone, against the larger spread 126: measurable), the one-stage fast lane +198.0 (FBLD alone less the head, against 126: measurable). The fast lane's share is close to its bound (+191.0, results above), which was fitted on #2037's head.

**Timing.** The head's worst setup at 61.44 MHz is +0.387 to +2.361 ns, against the baseline's +7.505 to +8.044 ns: the one-stage fast lane spends the clock headroom, as amendment 2 says, and a later DE25 clock raise needs the pipelining back.
